prose: Is Fomenko’s New Chronology legit? Chance Garton and Dylan Saccoccio investigate the evidence behind Anatoly Fomenko’s radical claim that much of ancient history happened in the Middle Ages, and put his astronomical dating arguments to the test.

Fomenko says the Book of Revelation was written during the Renaissance, and the Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse contain a date hidden in symbolism. We explore Nikolai Morozov’s influence on New Chronology, compare his interpretation with Fomenko’s proposed date of 1486 AD.
ext: The conversation continues into planetary color correspondences, Zechariah’s horse visions, and Thucydides’ accounts of solar and lunar eclipses.
